description.value:
The Weapon Master archetype represents the pinnacle of personal-arms training, a Fighter who has dedicated themselves to true mastery of a chosen weapon category — blaster, lightweapon, or vibroweapon — until its use becomes an extension of instinct rather than conscious thought.

Weapon Masters develop signature techniques unique to their chosen arms, gain the ability to swap between multiple mastered weapons without missing a beat, and eventually reach a level of precision that lets them turn even a glancing blow into a decisive one.
